config.provider.enum.0: POST {baseUrl}/audio/transcriptions with a WAV file. Works with whisper.cpp server, speaches, faster-whisper-server, LocalAI, OpenAI, Groq, ...
config.provider.enum.1: Run whisper.cpp CLI on a local .bin model — no server and no HTTP. Point `local.modelPath` at the model file or folder.
config.provider.enum.2: Run GigaAM / any NeMo-CTC ONNX model locally through sherpa-onnx. Point `onnx.modelPath` at the model folder.
config.provider.enum.3: Sber SaluteSpeech REST API (GigaAM acoustic model on Sber's cloud, shares the GigaChat OAuth flow).
config.provider.enum.4: Run a local CLI per segment and read the recognized text from stdout.
config.language.markdownDescription: Recognition language, e.g. `ru`, `ru-RU`, `en`. `auto` follows the built-in `#accessibility.voice.speechLanguage#` setting.
config.insert.target.enum.0: Focus the Copilot Chat input and paste recognized text there.
config.insert.target.enum.1: Insert recognized text at the cursor of the active editor.
config.insert.target.enum.2: Only put the final text on the clipboard.
config.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescrip: Show the microphone in the status bar. It turns red while recording; clicking it opens or hides the dictation panel.
config.chatMic.hideBuiltin.markdownDescr: On first install, hide the built-in microphone in the Copilot chat input (`dictation.showButton: false`) so it does not compete with this extension. Applied once: if you bring it back with **Show / Hide Built-in Chat Microphone**, later windows leave it alone. Set to `false` to never touch it.
config.chatMic.runInAgentsWindow.markdow: Allow this extension to run in the **Agents window** (`extensions.supportAgentsWindow`). That window blocks third-party extensions by default. Note: its status bar is hidden by design and extension views are not supported there, so dictation in that window works via the `Ctrl+Alt+D` / `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C` shortcuts and the `panel` control mode.
config.panel.enabled.markdownDescription: Deprecated alias kept for compatibility. Use `#customDictation.controls#` instead.
config.controls.markdownDescription: Where the live recording display is shown. VS Code does not let extensions pin a status bar popover like the Copilot one (only core can), so a toast is used by default.
config.controls.enum.0: Floating toast above the status bar: the timer only, plus ✕ to cancel. Appears over the editor and does not steal focus.
config.controls.enum.1: Pinned editor tab, one row: live div waveform, timer, a round stop button and a copy-to-clipboard icon button.
config.controls.enum.2: Only the microphone in the status bar.
config.insert.chatMode.enum.0: Paste with `editor.action.clipboardPasteAction`; keeps the existing chat draft (clipboard is restored afterwards).
config.insert.chatMode.enum.1: Set the whole chat input through `workbench.action.chat.open`; replaces the existing draft.
config.insert.fallbackToClipboard.markdo: If recognized text could not be inserted (chat input unavailable, editor rejected it), copy the whole transcript to the clipboard as a fallback and tell the user.
config.audio.ffmpegPath.markdownDescript: Path to the `ffmpeg` binary used to capture microphone audio as 16 kHz mono PCM.
config.audio.inputFormat.markdownDescrip: ffmpeg capture backend. `auto` picks `dshow` on Windows, `avfoundation` on macOS and `pulse` on Linux.
config.audio.device.markdownDescription: Microphone name or index. Leave empty to use the first available input device. Use **Custom Dictation: Select Microphone** to pick one.
config.audio.cues.start.markdownDescript: Play a short cue when recording starts.
config.audio.cues.end.markdownDescriptio: Play a short cue when recording stops (including auto-stop and cancel).
config.audio.cues.volume.markdownDescrip: Volume of the sound cues in percent. `15` is a quiet notification, `100` is the full level of the bundled recording, `0` silences the cues without disabling them.
config.audio.silenceMs.markdownDescripti: Pause length that ends a phrase and sends it for recognition.
config.audio.minSegmentMs.markdownDescri: Phrases shorter than this are treated as noise and dropped.
config.audio.maxSegmentMs.markdownDescri: Hard cut for continuous speech without pauses.
config.audio.autoStopSilenceMs.markdownD: Stop recording automatically after this long without any voice, in milliseconds: `60000` is one minute (default), `30000` is 30 seconds, `0` disables auto-stop. A notification tells you why recording ended.
config.audio.noiseThreshold.markdownDesc: Voice-activity threshold as normalized RMS (`0.01` ≈ -40 dBFS). `0` enables automatic noise-floor tracking. Raise it in a noisy room.
config.openai.baseUrl.markdownDescriptio: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API. The extension calls `{baseUrl}/audio/transcriptions`.
config.openai.model.markdownDescription: Model name sent in the `model` form field, e.g. `whisper-1`, `Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3`, `large-v3-turbo`.
config.openai.extraBody.markdownDescript: Extra multipart form fields sent with every request, e.g. `{ "vad_filter": "true", "hotwords": "Copilot, VS Code" }`.
config.openai.prompt.markdownDescription: Prompt / vocabulary hint sent to the model (names, jargon, `Это диктовка по-русски.`).
config.openai.sendContextPrompt.markdown: Also send the tail of the already recognized text as a prompt so phrases stay consistent.
config.salute.clientId.markdownDescripti: SaluteSpeech client id (only needed when no authorization key is stored).
config.salute.insecureTLS.markdownDescri: Skip TLS certificate verification. Needed when Sber hosts are signed by the Russian Trusted Root CA, which is missing from Node's certificate store.
config.command.capture.markdownDescripti: Custom recorder command. When set it is used **instead of** ffmpeg and must write raw **s16le, 16 kHz, mono** PCM to stdout. Example: `sox -q -t waveaudio default -r 16000 -c 1 -b 16 -e signed-integer -t raw -`.
config.command.transcribe.markdownDescri: CLI used when `#customDictation.provider#` is `command`. `${file}` is replaced with the path of a WAV file; stdout (or the file `${out}`) must contain the text. Example: `whisper-cli -m C:/models/ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin -f ${file} -l ru -nt`.
config.local.modelPath.markdownDescripti: Path to a whisper.cpp model (`.bin`) **or** to a folder that contains `ggml-*.bin` models — the most capable one is picked automatically (`turbo` → `large-v3` → … → `tiny`).
config.local.executablePath.markdownDesc: Path to `whisper-cli` (or `whisper-cli.exe`) from a whisper.cpp release. Empty means: look next to the model, in `bin/` and `build/bin/`, then on `PATH`.
config.local.extraArgs.markdownDescripti: Extra whisper.cpp CLI arguments appended to every run, e.g. `--threads 8 --temperature 0`.
config.onnx.modelPath.markdownDescriptio: Folder with a sherpa-onnx NeMo-CTC model (`model.onnx`/`model.int8.onnx` + `tokens.txt`) — for example a converted **GigaAM-v3** — or the `.onnx` file itself.
config.onnx.executablePath.markdownDescr: Path to `sherpa-onnx-offline` from a sherpa-onnx release. Empty means: look next to the model, in `bin/`, then on `PATH`.
config.onnx.precision.markdownDescriptio: Which `.onnx` in the folder to use. `auto` prefers `int8` (smaller, faster on CPU).
config.onnx.mode.markdownDescription: How the sherpa-onnx provider is executed.
config.onnx.mode.enum.0: Use the warm websocket server when `sherpa-onnx-offline-websocket-server` sits next to the CLI, otherwise one process per phrase.
config.onnx.mode.enum.1: Always keep `sherpa-onnx-offline-websocket-server` running: the model is loaded once, each phrase takes ~0.2 s.
config.onnx.mode.enum.2: Start `sherpa-onnx-offline` per phrase: simplest, but the model is reloaded for every phrase.
config.speechProvider.enabled.markdownDe: Register this extension as VS Code's speech provider so **editor** and **terminal** dictation use your backend too. Requires starting VS Code with `--enable-proposed-api local.custom-dictation` and a restart.
